title: Sentinel-2 steam plumes reveal whether a US power plant is running (leave-whole-plants-out)
one_liner: On plants the model never saw, a label-free plume detector separates on/off with AUC 0.86 (537 off-scenes, 41 plants) and ranks load with Spearman 0.57.

mechanism: Wet cooling towers and wet-FGD stacks emit water vapour roughly in proportion to heat rejected; it condenses into a visible white plume whose size depends on load and on ambient temperature/humidity.
method: 46 US plants chosen from EIA-860 cooling data (26 natural-draft, 15 mechanical-draft, 5 once-through), 3 years of Sentinel-2 (9,276 chips at 20 m, TCI+SCL). Plume = bright whiteness anomaly (vs rolling 30th-percentile clear reference) in connected components attached to OSM cooling-tower/chimney locations; cloud guards: SCL cloud fraction away from source <10%, bright-away <3%, snow <20%, reject >0.8 km2 plumes touching chip border; shadow-displacement feature. Monotone gradient-boosted model on 7 image + 5 weather features, GroupKFold by plant (6 folds). Label = CEMS gross load in the overpass hour / 99.5th pct load.

results.metric: on/off AUC, all tower+FGD plants, image+weather model
results.note: 537 off scenes; raw plume area/GW AUC 0.814; on/off classifier AUC 0.880

results.metric: average precision for the OFF class (natural-draft)

results.note: ~28% of chips; ~21 usable scenes per plant-year

results.metric: mechanical-draft plants only: on/off AUC (first-pass model)

controls: Weather-only model (no image): AUC 0.56, Spearman 0.14 -> image carries the signal. Australian air-cooled plants (no towers) give Spearman ~0. Plant-bootstrap CIs in s2_us_bootstrap_ci.json.
known_or_novel: known (Climate TRACE / WattTime, Carbon Tracker 2018, Hanna 2021); our label-free OSM-anchored detector + leave-plants-out numbers are an independent replication with public data only
caveats: Cloud leakage is reduced, not eliminated (clouds sitting on the towers still pass; the border rule also removes some genuine very large cold-weather plumes). Load level within the ON state is weak (Spearman ~0.38-0.43). Only ~4% of plants worldwide have the required structures. Capacity proxy uses CEMS 99.5th-percentile load (nameplate would be used abroad). Validity rule and model form were refined once after seeing first-pass results (both versions saved: s2_model_results.csv, s2_model_results_v2_before_borderrule.csv).

title: Ambient weather limits plume visibility; conditioning on it helps a little, normalising by it does not
one_liner: On/off AUC is 0.97 below 5 C but 0.67 above 25 C; adding ERA5 weather to the model gains +0.070 Spearman (significant) but an explicit weather-normalised plume index gains nothing.

method: 7 Australian plants with wet cooling towers + 3 controls (2 air-cooled, 1 once-through lake-cooled); model trained on all 41 US plants; label = mean plant MW over the 25 min before each Sentinel-2 overpass / 99.5th pct. No Australian data touched the model or any threshold.

mechanism: NOx from the stack forms an NO2 plume a few TROPOMI pixels long; column enhancement downwind minus upwind should scale with emission rate.
method: 58 isolated CEMS plants (38 coal, 20 'gas' by EIA-860 dominant capacity; neighbours within 60 km emit <25-35% of own NOx). Daily qa>=0.75 composites on a 0.035 deg CONUS grid, 2023-07..2026-06 (1,096 days). Enhancement = mean of 55x24 km downwind box minus upwind median, ERA5 100 m wind at ~13:30 local; label = CEMS NOx over the 3 h before overpass. Ablations: no rotation, enh*u^a (a=0,0.5,1), 2-9 m/s filter.

results.note: NOx is decoupled from generation by SCR/low-NOx burners
median CEMS NOx passing 1037 lbs/h vs failing 410 lbs/h (literature detection limit ~240-870 lbs/h)

results.metric: daily r, coal vs gas-dominant plants

controls: Same pipeline, same plants, three estimator variants; simple unrotated disc-minus-annulus does as well as the wind-rotated box.
known_or_novel: known (literature reports 40-100% single-overpass error); our null on wind rotation is specific to this crude box estimator
caveats: Daily composite mixes orbits; overpass time approximated as 13:30 local solar; no AMF/plume-height correction; 0.035 deg regridded product, not native pixels.

mechanism: Averaging ~10-20 valid overpasses beats down retrieval/meteorological noise; NO2 lifetime varies with temperature, so a temperature coefficient learned on training plants is applied to test plants.
method: 42 plants passing the label-free detectability screen. Index = 30-day rolling mean of wind-filtered enhancement / plant long-run mean, divided by exp(b*(T-15)), b learned on training plants (GroupKFold 6). Linear calibration to relative CEMS NOx (30-day all-hours mean / plant mean) with 10-90% residual band from training folds; evaluated on non-overlapping windows of held-out plants. Outage = 30-day NOx <30% of plant normal vs >70%.

mechanism: Strikes, fuel disruption, evacuation and industrial shutdown reduce combustion of all kinds; TROPOMI sees total NOx within ~10-50 km, not the plant alone.

caveats: WHAT WE CAN SAY: a theatre-wide 30-50% drop in NO2 near large combustion sites during the war window, recovering by May-June in the Gulf and only partly in Iran. Only 8-25 valid days per site in the window. Placebo distribution has ~40 overlapping windows from a single pre-war year. GPPD coordinates are off by 1-3 km at several sites (Qurayyah, Faras) and unverifiable at 3 (Al-Anbar, Al-Shemal, Jazan).
